international_aviation.headline: Anduril YFQ-44A Fury無人機摧毀目標 仍需人工批准方可發射
international_aviation.summary: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，Anduril 開發的 YFQ-44A Fury 無人機近期在測試中摧毀目標，證實其作戰能力。然而，在美國空軍未來的相關作戰任務中，該款新式戰鬥無人機仍必須由人員進行確認與批准，方能執行發射命令。
international_aviation.headline_en: Anduril YFQ-44A Fury Drone Destroys Target But Still Requires Human Approval to Fire
international_aviation.summary_en: According to reporting by Simple Flying, Anduril's YFQ-44A Fury drone recently successfully destroyed a target, providing proof of its operational combat capability. However, despite proving what the uncrewed aircraft can achieve, human operators must remain directly in the command loop for future operations involving the US Air Force's combat drone fleet. As a result of these established operational rules, the new combat drone still cannot fire weapons without receiving explicit human authorization prior to engagement.

international_aviation.headline: IATA：2026年6月全球航空客運需求年減1.7%，貨運成長8.5%
international_aviation.summary: IATA公布2026年6月數據，全球客運需求（RPK）較2025年同期下降1.7%，主因為中國、美國及日本國內市場下滑；中東航空業者國際需求年減14%，但降幅較前月縮小。同期全球航空貨運需求（CTK）年增8.5%，所有地區均呈正成長，以北美洲業者13.1%增幅最大。
international_aviation.headline_en: IATA: Global Air Passenger Demand Down 1.7% in June 2026, Cargo Up 8.5%
international_aviation.summary_en: IATA reported that total air passenger demand (RPK) fell 1.7% year-on-year in June 2026, driven by domestic market declines in China, the US, and Japan. Middle East carriers saw a 14% international demand decline, though the rate of decline halved since April. Global air cargo demand (CTK) rose 8.5% year-on-year, with all regions in positive territory and North American carriers posting the strongest growth at 13.1%.

sources.name: IATA — Air Passenger Demand Falls 1.7% in June
IATA — Air Cargo Demand Strengthens in June, Up 8.5%

international_aviation.headline: 波音777-9測試機隊時數達4800小時 第7架將進行ETOPS認證
international_aviation.summary: 根據Simple Flying報導，波音777-9型客機測試機隊的累計測試飛行時間已達到4800小時。同時，一架剛出廠的第7架測試機體將加入機隊，並負責執行雙發延程飛行（ETOPS）認證相關測試，持續推進該機型的驗證程序。
international_aviation.headline_en: Boeing 777-9 Test Fleet Reaches 4,800 Hours as 7th Aircraft Prepares for ETOPS Certification
international_aviation.summary_en: According to report material from Simple Flying, the Boeing 777-9 test aircraft fleet has successfully accumulated a total of 4,800 test flight hours during its ongoing flight testing activities. In addition, a newly built seventh airframe is joining the expanding test fleet of the twinjet aircraft type. This factory-fresh seventh aircraft will be assigned to carry out upcoming Extended-range Twin-engine Operational Performance Standards (ETOPS) certification testing as part of the overall certification program for the Boeing 777-9.

ground_and_maritime.headline: 國防部偵獲12架次共機及7艘共艦 10架次逾越台海中線
ground_and_maritime.summary: 台灣國防部公布，自7月29日至30日上午6時止，共偵獲中國軍機12架次、軍艦7艘次及公務船1艘，其中有10架次共機逾越台海中線進入西南與東部空域。國軍已運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統進行監控。根據本站統計，今日偵獲軍機架次較前一日的6架次有所增加。
ground_and_maritime.headline_en: Taiwan Detects 12 Chinese Aircraft and 7 Warships Near Strait
ground_and_maritime.summary_en: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense detected 12 Chinese military aircraft, 7 warships, and 1 official ship near the island between July 29 and July 30, 2026. Among these, 10 aircraft crossed the Taiwan Strait median line into the southwestern and eastern airspace. Taiwan's military utilized aircraft, vessels, and missile systems to monitor the situation. According to AVWIRE database statistics, this marks an increase in military aircraft compared to the 6 aircraft recorded on the previous day, July 29.

Among the 12 detected Chinese military aircraft, 10 crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait and entered southwestern and eastern airspace.
Taiwan's military utilized mission aircraft, vessels, and shore-based missile systems to closely monitor and respond to the situation.
